name: twitter_agent_topics
description: Broad discovery themes for technical builders and founders. Keywords are starting points for finding relevant conversations, not a fixed editorial position or a list of personal projects.

quick_presets.core_tech: "machine learning", "AI agents", "software engineering", "developer tools", cybersecurity, robotics
quick_presets.ai_and_agents: "large language models", "open source models", "AI agents", "agentic workflow", "workflow automation"
quick_presets.founders_and_products: "startup founder", bootstrapping, "product market fit", "customer discovery", "build in public"
quick_presets.work_and_wellbeing: "developer career", "future of work", "developer burnout", "digital wellbeing", "human AI interaction"

topics.name: AI & Machine Learning
topics.summary: Model releases, research, evaluations, inference, and practical uses of machine learning across products and industries.
topics.watch_query: "machine learning", "large language models", "generative AI", "open source models"

topics.name: AI Agents & Automation
topics.summary: Building and operating agents, tool integrations, automated workflows, and human oversight for useful real-world tasks.

topics.name: Software Engineering & Developer Tools
topics.summary: Software design, coding tools, testing, open-source software, cloud infrastructure, and reliable production systems.

topics.name: Cybersecurity & Privacy
topics.summary: Application and infrastructure security, AI threats, data protection, cryptography, and privacy-preserving systems.

topics.name: Startups & Product Building
topics.summary: Finding customer problems, building and launching products, bootstrapping, distribution, pricing, and learning from founder experiences.
topics.watch_query: "startup founder", bootstrapping, "product market fit", "build in public"

topics.name: Blockchain & Digital Finance
topics.summary: Blockchain infrastructure and applications, digital payments, stablecoins, asset tokenization, and decentralized finance.

topics.name: Science & Emerging Technology
topics.summary: Robotics, computing hardware, scientific breakthroughs, and the transition from research to practical technologies and businesses.

topics.name: Work, Careers & Education
topics.summary: Engineering careers, technical learning, mentorship, changing work practices, and opportunities through grants, hackathons, fellowships, and remote jobs.
topics.watch_query: "developer career", "builder grants", hackathon, "developer fellowship", "remote job", "free education"

topics.name: Technology & Society
topics.summary: How technology affects institutions, economies, public trust, access, and everyday life, including competing perspectives on policy and governance.

topics.name: Digital Life & Wellbeing
topics.summary: Attention, sustainable work habits, burnout, digital wellbeing, and how people experience and adapt to technology and AI.
